newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 13.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 13.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A hand grenade exploded this morning outside a Budapest pub.
- Opposition party FIDESZ would like to dissolve social security self-governments, while the cabinet would like to have it led by delegates.
- The Prime Minister's Office said Gyula HOrn is looking for a replacement for Welfare Minister Gyorgy Szabo, who offered his resignation last week.
- The government will have talks next week about the planned energy price increase with foreign investors of the utility sector.
- A thief who stole 3 kilogrammes of gold was caught in the east Hungarian town of Bekescsaba.
